description: Ex-NVA MiG-21M preserved on the air base; previously at the Technische Schule der Luftwaffe 3 at Faßberg. Inside the Fliegerhorst, normally only visible on open days. Identity from the NVA MiG-21 fate register at mig-21.de.
Ex-NVA MiG-21PF preserved on the air base wearing the Bundeswehr code 23+82; NVA number 877, earlier shown as 1982. Inside the Fliegerhorst. Identity from the NVA MiG-21 fate register at mig-21.de.
